senses.gloss: m. (λαβρᾶτον, λαυρεᾶτον, S.) the emperor’s portrait wreathed with laurels.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 356:2">Yalk. Ez. 356</cite> <he>נטלה לברנטין של מלך וֹכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) she took the king’s portrait and used it as fuel for making a hot drink.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 356:2">Ib.</cite> <he>בברנטן שלי</he> (corr. <he>בלב׳</he>); <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 9</cite> <cite ref="L00324"><he>לורטיא</he></cite>, read <he>לַוְרִיָטָא</he> (laureata, sc. imago). [Ar. s. v. <he>ברנט</he>, quotes a Var. <he>טורתק</he>, for <he>נוורתק</he>, a. expl. our w. = <cite ref="S00405"><he>קומקום</he></cite>.]
